observations: (1) PROBABLE IMPORTANT: Endpoint::parse accepts http:// only under #[cfg(test)], which applies only to in-crate unit tests; the plan's loopback tests are listed as the integration target `cargo test -p sc-agent-http --test ureq`, where the library compiles without cfg(test) and http://127.0.0.1 is refused. Plan must state the loopback tests are in-crate #[cfg(test)] unit tests (or TLS loopback with a test-only trust root). A cargo feature opening http would be unsafe under feature unification.

(3) minor: Retry-After grammar unstated; f64 parse accepts inf/NaN/1e9/-1 and Duration::from_secs_f64 panics on NaN/negative/overflow — specify ASCII digits with optional fraction; everything else malformed; add to the test table.
